description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayer class and related factory functions for managing Web Audio playback, including creation, control (play, pause, setEos), buffer management, volume control, and client notification within the Rialto media framework.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Implements the WebAudioPlayer class responsible for managing web audio playback, including buffer management, control commands, and client notifications within the Rialto framework.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Constructor initializing WebAudioPlayer with client, mime type, priority, config, IPC factory, and client controller, setting up shared memory and application state.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the client and resets IPC resources.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream via IPC.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay via IPC.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to shared memory and notifies via IPC.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume via IPC.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume via IPC.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a change in WebAudioPlayer state.
